question: What would come in (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fulfilled"** means feeling satisfied and happy because you are achieving your potential or doing meaningful work. (संतुष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** She felt fulfilled after completing her community project that helped underprivileged children.
 
 
 
• In the context of the passage, some young professionals are drawn to work that aligns with their personal values and gives them a sense of purpose and satisfaction.
 
• Other options do not convey the intended sense of meaningful satisfaction: "challenged" refers to difficulty, "comfortable" refers to ease, and "proud" refers to feeling pride.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Challenged** (चुनौतीपूर्ण) – Refers to being tested or facing difficulties. Example: The new project challenged her skills, but it did not provide long-term satisfaction.
 
• **Comfortable** (आरामदायक) – Refers to ease or lack of difficulty. Example: He chose a comfortable job with less stress, but it lacked purpose.
 
• **Proud** (गर्वित) – Refers to a feeling of pride or accomplishment. Example: She was proud of her achievement, yet it did not make her feel truly fulfilled.
